# Diagnostics: Wheel speed sensor failure in 4WD

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Move the 4WD selector lever into the 4X4 position with the engine off. [t274]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. With the engine off, move the 4WD selector lever into the 4X4 position.
2. Remove the IDPM cover and locate the ABS ECU fuse within it.
3. [Partial] Pull the identified ABS ECU fuse out of its slot in the IDPM.
4. Start the truck's engine while the fuse is removed from the panel.
5. After the engine runs, place the ABS ECU fuse back into the IDPM slot.
6. [Partial] If switching to 2WD later, repeat steps one through four to return to 4X4.

_Procedure reported by [t274]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-4x4-with-faulty-wheel-speed-sensor.9171/>_
